“`

“Ponder slowly.”

“I’m not in a hurry.”

Lin Yuan thought for a while and said,

“Although I have not comprehended the perfect Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter, the Sixth Stage Chapter is almost ready; I might as well organize it and upload it to the Goddess of Wisdom…”

Lin Yuan rubbed his forehead. The Sixth Stage Martial Tao Chapter incorporated the deep excavation of the physical body by the Body Cultivation lineage.

...

Theoretically, an Evolver who cultivated to the Sixth Stage Martial Tao had the potential to give birth to a Physical Body Divine Ability.

Of course, which Physical Body Divine Ability would emerge depended entirely on the fragments of Divine Skills deep within one’s own bloodline.

But no matter what, even if it was just an auxiliary Physical Body Divine Ability, it would be very useful to an Evolver.

Unlike secret techniques, invoking Divine Skills didn’t require any specific conditions; one could activate them with just a thought.

“Blood Rebirth…”

The breath within Lin Yuan’s body began to change, as streams of blood interwove and clashed, vaguely forming a mysterious pattern.

It was the ‘Blood Divine Skill’ that Lin Yuan had comprehended in the Central Earth World after paying a huge price, and then deduced according to the physical body of the Main World.

This technique was only applicable to Lin Yuan; even if someone else acquired it, they wouldn’t be able to form the technique imprint.

“Strictly speaking, can this physical body of mine also condense a new Physical Body Divine Ability?”

Lin Yuan pondered to himself.

After all, the Primordial Spirit of his current body was just at the beginning of the Sixth Rank; if he completed the Sixth Rank Chapter he had developed, it would naturally give birth to a new Physical Body Divine Ability.

“I’ll try it later.”

“First, I’ll organize the Sixth Rank Chapter and upload it.”

Lin Yuan was not in a hurry.

A day or two later,

Lin Yuan had mostly organized the Sixth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, making it more suitable for the Human Race of the Main World.

He then connected to the ‘Goddess of Wisdom’.

“Respected Citizen Lin Yuan, the Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to serve you…”

The solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“I want to upload the Sixth Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.”

Having said that,

Lin Yuan began uploading the content of the Sixth Rank Chapter.

“Citizen Lin Yuan, please wait, the Goddess of Wisdom is making a full assessment…”

The Goddess of Wisdom received the Sixth Stage Martial Tao Chapter and immediately began the assessment.

“Actually, the Immortal Cultivation System has never appeared in the Main World before…” Lin Yuan seemed to have thought of something.

He could definitely upload the Immortal Cultivation System to the Goddess of Wisdom in exchange for rewards.

But Lin Yuan thought for a while and gave up that idea.

The Immortal Cultivation System was surely established by some other entity; if he were to spread it in the Main World,

Wouldn’t he be assisting the entity that created the Immortal Path System?

Spreading one’s own Evolutionary Path or cultivation system was related to the ‘Ultimate Leap’; in this regard, Lin Yuan naturally didn’t want to labor in vain.

Besides,

The Immortal Cultivation System might have a high ceiling, reaching the Seventh Rank, Eighth Rank, or even the Ninth Rank.

But it came with great limitations, such as the need for Spiritual Energy, or a Spirit Root?

In the Main World’s Cosmic Starry Sky, many forms of energy were diffused, but those similar to Spiritual Energy were not plentiful.

The most crucial point was still the Spirit Root; at least according to Lin Yuan’s knowledge, the Human Race in the Main World did not possess such a concept.

If Lin Yuan were to upload the Immortal Cultivation System, the first thing he would need to do would be to adapt the Immortal Cultivation System to fit the Human Race of the Main World.

That meant he would have to deduce an alternative to the Spirit Root.

The cost of this was too great; with the time and effort, Lin Yuan would rather continue to comprehend the Martial Arts Evolution System, elevating it to the next level, which was far more worthwhile than the former.

…

While waiting for the final assessment from the Goddess of Wisdom, Lin Yuan began to check other information.

While five hundred years had passed in the Central Earth World, only just under four months had gone by in the Main World.

Lin Yuan pulled up the record of events, and gave it a cursory look.

“Wanyang Holy Son…”

Lin Yuan noted that Wanyang Holy Son sent him a message a month ago.

The general idea was,

He had already broken through to the Sixth Rank.

And hoped to spar with Lin Yuan again.

Wanyang Holy Son, a rare owner of the ‘Nine Yang Divine Meridian’ and who had spent a century sleeping in the depths of a star, had very profound foundations that could only truly manifest at the Sixth Rank.

At the peak of the Fifth Rank, Lin Yuan had fought with Wanyang Holy Son and ultimately crushed him.

Wanyang Holy Son still remembered this incident to this day. He was aware that Lin Yuan’s path of evolution was special, with perfect soul fusion, which greatly enhanced his combat power.

However, at the Sixth Rank, it wasn’t just the evolutionary path that mattered, but also one’s physical constitution and foundations.

After his breakthrough to the Sixth Rank, Wanyang Holy Son felt a qualitative change in his strength, regained confidence, and wanted to find Lin Yuan for a rematch to wash away his past shame.

“`

He had never defeated Lin Yuan, but at least he shouldn’t be overwhelmed like before, allowing Lin Yuan to make him admit defeat with just a few slaps.

“To spar with me…”

Lin Yuan suddenly fell silent.

In Wanyang Holy Son’s eyes, Lin Yuan had just stepped into the Sixth Stage Martial Tao , so he felt confident in challenging him.

But in reality.

Lin Yuan, at this moment, had already reached the pinnacle of Sixth Stage Martial Tao, and even embarked on a path towards the Seventh Stage.

The gap between him and Wanyang Holy Son was far greater than when they were both at the pinnacle of the Fifth Stage Martial Tao, by countless times.

At the pinnacle of the Fifth Stage Martial Tao, Wanyang Holy Son could still withstand a few slaps from Lin Yuan.

But now…

“Forget it.”

“There’s no need to waste time.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, with his current strength, sparring with Wanyang Holy Son was simply bullying.

He had sparred with Wanyang Holy Son before because he could gain insights during the process of sparring from the other party.

Now the gap between them was too great, and there was no comparability.

…

After replying to Wanyang Holy Son with “I don’t have time recently,” Lin Yuan continued browsing through the subsequent messages.

“The Heiyu Family…”

Lin Yuan saw several messages his senior brothers had sent him.

Because he had instructed them to enter seclusion before shuttling through space, his senior brothers just left him messages.

“The Heiyu Family colluded with different species?”

Lin Yuan’s expression became strange.

Before revealing his identity as Peak Master Shisan, Lin Yuan had some conflicts with Heiyu Ao of the Heiyu Family.

Subsequently, Heiyu Ao had used the influence of the Heiyu Family to suppress Lin Yuan.

After Lin Yuan broke through to the Sixth Stage and revealed his identity, the Heiyu Family became fearful, with Heiyu Mo bringing Heiyu Ao personally to the Chikun Main Star to see him, hoping to apologize.

But at the time, Lin Yuan was busy embedding his life mark into the cosmic starry skies and did not bother with them.

Later, when his senior brothers asked for Lin Yuan’s opinion,

Lin Yuan stated that he did not intend to make amends with the Heiyu Family.

With Lin Yuan’s word, his senior brothers had a plan in mind, intending to oppress the Heiyu Family through various means and completely cause their downfall.

This was the fate of offending a Peak Master of the Chikun lineage.

Even the Chikun Star Domain’s top five forces were essentially dogs raised by the Chikun lineage, and while other matters can be discussed, if they dared to bite their master, they wouldn’t have a reason to exist.

Originally, according to the second senior brother’s intention, it was to harass the Heiyu Family and conduct a thorough investigation.

After all, a force like the Heiyu Family that had been established for hundreds of thousands of years couldn’t withstand close scrutiny.

They could find an excuse anytime.

Out of respect for Lin Yuan, the second senior brother personally took charge of the investigation into the Heiyu Family.

However, upon investigation, the second senior brother discovered an issue.

The Heiyu Family was suspected of having had contacts with a different species.

The second brother had not found concrete evidence of the Heiyu Family’s contacts with different species.

But some things don’t require evidence, once the second brother discovered this, he immediately planned to take control of Heiyu Mo.

In any case, he planned to take away Heiyu Mo, the highest authority of the Heiyu Family, first.

To be cautious, the second brother secretly contacted the Chikun Star Lord.

Under the watchful eyes of the Chikun Star Lord, Heiyu Mo had no room to resist.

After being taken away, he was subjected to a soul search by the Human Alliance’s specialized Eighth Layer Evolver in soul abilities.

For a strong individual like Heiyu Mo, who could control his own memories, ordinary soul searches were useless.

But an Eighth Layer Evolver in soul abilities could construct a vast, illusory world where all memories from Heiyu Mo’s life would unfold within that phony realm.

Such a method could only be performed by an Eighth Layer Evolver in soul abilities, and such powerful beings were extremely rare.

“The Heiyu Family… is finished…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If they had only offended him, the Heiyu Family would be merely ‘declining’ and could gracefully exit the stage.

After all, the laws of the Human Alliance still stood, and it wasn’t possible to let such a large family succumb to mishap.

Lin Yuan’s senior brothers, in dealing with the Heiyu Family, only took actions that were investigative and adhered to the Alliance’s legal provisions.

But colluding with a different species.

That was tantamount to betraying the Human Alliance; regardless of whether the other clansmen of the Heiyu Family knew or not, they were finished.

While Lin Yuan was reflecting on this,

a solemn and cold voice came through.

“Respected Sixth Rank citizen Lin Yuan, the Sixth Rank Chapter you uploaded has been judged as complete…”

The voice of the Goddess of Wisdom rang out.
